title: Alkoholisierter Kleintransporterfahrer ohne Fahrerlaubnis fährt gegen Motorrad

extraction.summaryEn: A van driver without a valid driving licence and with about 1.8 per mille alcohol collided with a motorcyclist at the Brunnenstraße/Bernauer Straße junction. The 18-year-old motorcyclist was injured and taken to hospital.
